message: Implement the three.js side of a controlled live in-place crane editing benchmark. INITIAL READ-ONLY: inspect the frozen shared contract and your own existing scene, then report readiness and implementation plan. No writes, tests, servers, browser launches or descendants until a separate bounded permit. Correlation: 11a86aaa5803e46cfb9178d7c3b7e8f02b446d2e9b41d5f1a636203b07fca265. Repo /workspace/scratch/0190a8c72f8a/aperture-recovery-20261002; read AGENTS.md. Frozen contract: benchmarks/crane-live-edits-20261003/harness/contract.mjs, SHA256 13826efcd14fe234f299d267c9938bdb36cde53026e66995a7344131a3050e09. Read only your engine's clean source at benchmarks/crane-wall-continuity-20261003/sources/b-continuous-front-quarter, its original engine source/docs and the five shared files under benchmarks/crane-reference-20261003 (author-brief.md, scene-manifest.json, three reference PNGs). Do not inspect the other engine's authored source, reference builder/Blender/GLB, other author or reviews; do not contact another author. Existing reference and geometry are reused, no new visual authoring challenge. Later exclusive output: benchmarks/crane-live-edits-20261003/author-b/v1. Implement the exact adapter contract: common harness owns 29 states, GPU fence, PNG capture and immutable state recording. Baseline then two cycles of all seven independent edits with baseline reset after each. Keep one real native canvas/renderer/device/scene/worker per attempt and genuine mesh/entity identities stable. No reload, recreation of all scene objects or renderer replacement to simulate an edit. Use native dynamic asset/geometry updates; count real geometry/buffer replacements separately. Aperture must preserve app/worker/ECS authority and use existing meshes.publish/dynamic APIs as appropriate. three.js must use pinned WebGPURenderer with fallback disabled. Actual worker revision must correlate to the submitted native frame before resolving applyAndSubmit; a queue counter alone is insufficient. Expose full current source and exact actual native buffers/world matrices, genuine identity/resource counters with definitions, and any validation errors. Preserve the current camera, appearance and continuous wall geometry; do not silently tune shadows/materials. Existing seven edit parameters remain exact. Parent independently compares live world triangles to retained static native goldens. One initial source submission plus one revision after your own native attempt; at most three native attempts including failures per engine, launched only by parent through adopted wrapper/runVerifiedScene. Same inherited model and xhigh effort; exact model identity/full transcripts unavailable, so exploratory only, no scores. No new dependencies, engine edits or publication. Static syntax/CPU checks only after permit; disposable fixtures only via adopted cleanup lifecycle/root, unique evidence retained outside temporary storage. Preserve every attempt and report source hashes, known limits and quiescence. Report useful results right away, before scratch notes. If work remains, use collaboration.send_message; otherwise return the result. Keep your status report short; complete the research and deliverable at the depth the task requires. If authorization is missing, or the reviewer denies an action for that reason, pause and report the exact action, target, and blocker to me. If I send <transcript_evidence> that authorizes that action and target, proceed; if already denied, retry the same tool call once. Don’t add the evidence to tool arguments. If the evidence is insufficient or the retry is denied, stop and report back. If you delegate that action, forward the block unchanged.
